## Analyst characterizes TSMC as fully priced despite strong AI demand

A 'fully priced' call on TSM despite AI demand strength signals the market may be near peak expectations on the foundry-as-bottleneck thesis; for existing longs, this is a valuation ceiling flag — the bull case now requires AI demand to exceed current ramp forecasts, not merely meet them.

- A SimplyWall.st analysis describes TSMC as fully priced at current levels.
- The argument acknowledges strong AI demand as a fundamental backdrop but concludes current valuation has already captured it.
- No specific price target, multiple, or earnings estimate is cited in the headline.
- Medium classifier confidence; this is a single independent analyst view, not a tier-1 bank action.
